title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 6.11 Buying or Leasing a Car: Evaluate basics of car purchasing.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 6.11 Buying or Leasing a Car: Evaluate basics of car purchasing.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "6.11 Buying or Leasing a Car", prints these objectives: "Evaluate basics of car purchasing." "Compute purchase payments and identify the related interest cost." "Evaluate the basics of leasing a car." "Identify and contrast the pros and cons of purchasing versus leasing a car." "Investigate the types of car insurance." "Solve application problems involving owning and maintaining a car.". This card reports that page.
